newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss astrologer says dump stocks before Friday.
newsitem.headline: Swiss astrologer says dump stocks before Friday.

text.p: A Swiss bourse astrologer is warning investors to dump stocks before an unusual configuration of the stars sets the cosmic stage for explosive events on financial markets on Friday.

Astrologer Alexander Linggi -- whose suggestion a year ago that Wall Street would turn down sharply and that gold would climb did not materialise -- also cited technical analysis showing the stock market was overbought and due for a downward correction.
"Leave the party now when it is at its best," he advised investors in the latest edition of his "Trends & Cycles" newsletter.

"We will see the constellation of the century for various important planets," Linggi told Reuters, saying Mars, Pluto, Uranus, Jupiter and Saturn would all be involved in the harmonious celestial line-up.
But Mars, the planet responsible for financial markets, would stand in opposition to Saturn.
"This lends the constellation explosive power," he said, adding that the rare configuration had alarm bells ringing among astrologers.
The famous stock market crash of October 1987 followed a similar line-up in August of that year, he said.
